articles.summary: USDA’s upcoming rule change will open the door to online WIC nationwide, giving more families the option to use their benefits to buy groceries online.
articles.title: Online WIC’s next big step: Nationwide access

articles.summary: WIC recipients are some of the most high-value shoppers. If you help them to use their benefits online, you’ll win their business and earn their loyalty.
articles.title: Be one of the first retailers to offer online WIC
